title: The Flame Bodhi Pill
summary: Tang Zhen explains that his daughter Tang Huo Er failed to absorb the Nine Dragon Lightning Flame and will die within a year. The seventh-tier Flame Bodhi Pill is his last chance to save her. He, Master Huan and Xiao Yan refine it for ten days in the Mountain Melting Cauldron. Master Huan runs out of Spiritual Strength at the last step, and Xiao Yan finishes the pill alone. His Earth Demon Puppet takes the Pill Lightning. Three days later, the valley's elders object to giving away the Sky Fire Three Mysterious Changes, and one reveals that Yan Xiao is Xiao Yan, the man who defeated Feng Qing Er. Xiao Yan unmasks and agrees to survive ten blows from Second Elder Wu Chen, an Eight-Star Dou Zong, and he meets the last blow with the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame.
events: Tang Zhen tells of Tang Huo Er's year left to live.
The three refine the Flame Bodhi Pill in the Mountain Melting Cauldron.
Master Huan fails at the last step; Xiao Yan asks to go on alone.
Xiao Yan completes the pill, and the Earth Demon Puppet takes the Pill Lightning.
The elders object, and Xiao Yan's identity is exposed.
Second Elder Wu Chen tests him with ten blows.
Xiao Yan matches the Celestial Astral Stone Crushing Steps with the Three Thousand Lightning Movement.
Wu Chen's Taiyi Infernal Luo Talisman meets the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame.
cultivation: Wu Chen is an Eight-Star Dou Zong.
